description: This is the main startup class of the Apache OFBiz framework, responsible for handling server startup, shutdown, status checks, and command-line argument parsing. It implements a singleton pattern to control the server instance and manages server state transitions in a thread-safe manner.

classes.name: Start
classes.description: Main singleton class for controlling the OFBiz server startup, shutdown, and status. Manages server state, executes command-line interfaces, and maintains configuration.

classes.name: ServerState
classes.description: Enum representing the server states: STARTING, RUNNING, STOPPING.

classes.name: CommandType
classes.description: Enum representing command types (HELP, STATUS, SHUTDOWN, START) determined from command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point method that parses command-line args and dispatches commands such as start, stop, status, or help.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Start class.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server and terminates the JVM.
